lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: US-R1-001 (CAM-363 review round 1) addressed the WARNING finding: the two 'BOTH streams' tests in test/supervisor/plan/plan-preflight.test.ts (typecheck ~line 235, bun-test ~line 288) previously asserted only `detail.toContain(...)` per stream, which passes identically regardless of stream order. Added two extra assertions per test: `result.detail.split('\n')[0]).toContain(<verdict>)` (first-line ordering check) and `truncatePreflightDetail(result.detail)).toContain(<verdict>)` (imported from src/supervisor/plan-preflight-marker.ts), which directly exercises the truncation path an operator actually sees. Verified the regression-catching property empirically: temporarily reversed [typecheck.stdout, typecheck.stderr] order in src/supervisor/plan-preflight.ts, confirmed the new assertion failed, then reverted (source untouched, only the test file changed -- git diff on plan-preflight.ts is empty). Two SUGGESTION-severity findings from the same review round were NOT addressed (out of scope for this fix, which targets the single WARNING only): (1) the four-way duplicated `[stderr, stdout].filter(...).join('\n').trim()` expression at plan-preflight.ts:86/94/117/128 could be extracted to a `combineStreams()` helper; (2) AC8's oracle form for clean-tree (`! grep ... | grep -q ...`) is near-tautological and can't fail. If a future round re-raises either as a WARNING (not just a SUGGESTION), address it then.
